steps.message:
## Summary

I've identified and fixed the bug in the AnkiDroid Card Browser's multi-select mode when changing note types.

### Root Cause
When multiple cards from different notes were selected in the Card Browser and the user clicked "Edit" to change the note type:
1. The "Edit" menu item was only visible when all selected cards belonged to a **single note** (via `hasSelectedSingleNoteId()`)
2. When multiple notes were selected, the user couldn't change the note type at all
3. Even when a single note was selected, only one card was opened in the note editor

### Fix Applied (4 files modified)

**1. `AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/anki/CardBrowser.java`**
- Added `mTargetModelId` field to store the selected target model
- Changed the "Edit" button visibility from `hasSelectedSingleNoteId()` to `hasSelectedCards()` so it shows for any selection
- Added logic: if single note selected → open note editor; if multiple notes → show model selection dialog
- Added `showChangeModelDialog()` to display a dialog listing all available note types
- Added `executeChangeModelCollectionTask()` to perform the batch change via CollectionTask
- Added `mChangeModelHandler` to handle the result (success with undo snackbar, or error toast)

**2. `AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/async/CollectionTask.java`**
- Added `CHANGE_MODEL_MULTI` case in `doInBackgroundDismissNotes()` that:
  - Gets unique notes from selected cards
  - Builds identity field mapping (field N → field N) and card mapping
  - Calls `col.getModels().change()` with all note IDs
  - Handles `ConfirmModSchemaException` gracefully
  - Stores undo information

**3. `AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/libanki/Collection.java`**
- Added `CHANGE_MODEL_MULTI` to `DismissType` enum
- Added undo handling for `CHANGE_MODEL_MULTI` that restores original field values and regenerates cards
- Added `markUndo` support to save undo information

**4. `AnkiDroid/src/main/res/values/` (resource files)**
- Added `undo_action_change_model_multi` string for undo label
- Added `changed_model_message` string for success toast
- Added `card_browser_change_note_type` string for dialog title

### Result
- Users can now select cards from **multiple notes** in the browser
- Clicking "Edit" shows a dialog listing all available note types
- Selecting a note type applies it to **all selected notes** via batch operation
- Full undo support via the undo snackbar
